title: About Disprz | Our Mission, Team & Story
markdown:
# People are an organization's greatest lever for growth

HR and L&D leaders have always known this. Disprz exists to enable it and make it measurable. A AI-powered learning and skilling platform that closes capability gaps, builds careers, and ties learning directly to business outcomes. Today, 3.5M+ learners across 500+ enterprises trust us to move their people and their business forward.


## We are a global learning and skilling company, and we are just getting started

Today we are a team of 200+ colleagues spread across every continent, partnering with 500+ enterprises and proud to be part of the careers of 3.5 million learners worldwide.
